name: Adelaide
housing: Adelaide renters mainly live in houses, villas and units, many built of stone or brick.

localRules.text: In South Australia the bond is lodged with Consumer and Business Services.
South Australia uses a standard Inspection Sheet, completed and signed at the start and end of the tenancy.

tenantHelp.name: RentRightSA (Tenant Advice and Advocacy Service)
tenantHelp.what: free tenancy advice and advocacy in SA

climate: Test the air conditioning and check for cracks in walls; Adelaide summers are very hot and the clay soil moves.
fact: In South Australia the condition report is called an Inspection Sheet.
